Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
Data Scientist | Machine Learning, Forecasting and Experimentation
[EMAIL] | [PHONE] | [LINKEDIN]

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Data scientist with experience developing forecasting, churn propensity and experimentation solutions. Built scheduled and batch-scored machine-learning workflows used in business operations, including a six-week recipe-demand forecast that improved WAPE from 23% to 14%. Hands-on with Python, SQL, BigQuery and Vertex AI Workbench, with experience in feature engineering, model evaluation and automated testing. Seeking to grow into the production engineering side of machine learning.

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Programming: Python, SQL, R
Machine learning and analytics: LightGBM, XGBoost, scikit-learn, pandas, statsmodels, SHAP, feature engineering, model evaluation, forecasting, experimentation
Tools: BigQuery, Vertex AI Workbench, dbt, Looker, Streamlit, Docker, pytest, R Markdown

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Data Scientist | Thistlebox | 2022-Present
• Built a weekly recipe-demand forecasting workflow for six weeks ahead by recipe and region, using LightGBM with calendar, price and menu-position features.
• Improved forecast WAPE from 23% to 14%; the work was associated with an estimated 9% reduction in food waste. The scheduled Vertex AI Workbench notebook writes forecasts to BigQuery for operations reporting in Looker.
• Developed a weekly XGBoost churn-propensity scoring workflow in BigQuery and used top-decile scores to target retention offers. A 10% holdout validation found churn was down 2.1 percentage points in the treated group.
• Built a Streamlit calculator for planning and analysing sequential A/B tests, used by approximately 25 people in product and growth. Wrote the app and Dockerfile; the data platform team handles Cloud Run hosting and deployment.
• Since 2025, have written pytest unit tests for forecasting feature code, reaching approximately 60% coverage.
• Delivered the internal training “Stats for PMs” three times.

Junior Data Analyst | Firth Energy Retail | 2020-2022
• Segmented customers and analysed tariffs using R and SQL.
• Automated monthly regulator reports with R Markdown, saving the team approximately two days each month.

SELECTED PROJECTS
Image Classification Course Project | 2025
• Fine-tuned a small CNN in PyTorch on a public food-images dataset as part of an online deep-learning course, achieving approximately 80% accuracy. Learning project using PyTorch, torchvision and Google Colab.

EDUCATION
MSc in Statistics
Dissertation: Bayesian hierarchical models
docs.cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Machine Learning Engineer – Customer Support AI role at Quillstone Payments. My data-science experience combines machine-learning workflows, experimentation and practical engineering improvements, and I am keen to grow further into the production engineering side of machine learning.

At Thistlebox, I built a six-week recipe-demand forecasting workflow that improved WAPE from 23% to 14%, with an estimated 9% reduction in food waste. I also developed weekly BigQuery churn scoring used to target retention offers; a 10% holdout validation found churn was down 2.1 percentage points in the treated group. These projects have given me hands-on experience with Python, feature engineering, model evaluation and workflows that inform business operations.

My work so far has focused on scheduled notebook and batch-scoring workflows rather than independently deployed model APIs. I wrote the Dockerfile for a Streamlit sequential-testing app, which the data platform team hosts on Cloud Run, and since 2025 I have been writing pytest unit tests for forecasting feature code, reaching approximately 60% coverage. I am interested in Quillstone’s focus on taking AI ideas from prototype to production in collaboration with backend engineers, data scientists and product managers, particularly to help merchants and support teams get answers with less friction.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience in applied machine learning and experimentation could contribute to Quillstone’s Customer Operations AI team.

Kind regards,
Tobias Mwangi-Hartley
